title: feat(spec,lint): an action's confirmText, successMessage and errorMessage are template slots over the roots the console runner binds
body:
Fixes #24814

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Ruling-ref: 6365736632

An action's person-facing copy (`confirmText`, `successMessage`, `errorMessage`) is now an ADR-0032 `template` slot over the roots the console's action runner binds. This is ruling A's second half: the console moved first (objectui #13409, in the pinned `.objectui-sha` `2958f17e9c6a`), and this PR types the action-copy family. It uses the #24947 form: the blank arm is kept, door findings are warnings, and the judge prescribes `{{ }}` for a `${…}` token. The refusal half is its own BREAKING card, to be filed once this lands. Nothing here refuses text that parses today.

## What changes

- **The 9 row slots** (`action:button`, `action:icon`, the `action:group` / `action:menu` member, × `confirmText` / `successMessage` / `errorMessage`, `ui/component.zod.ts`) and **`ActionSchema.confirmText` / `successMessage`** (`ui/action.zod.ts`, which `InlineActionSchema` picks) are `template` slots. A bare string is shorthand for `{ dialect: 'template', source }`. The envelope is accepted, and a blank string still parses. `ActionSchema` keeps its inline locale map arm.
- **Roots, measured at the runner** (objectui `ActionRunner` at `2958f17e9c6a`, `confirmMessage` / `composeSuccessMessage` / `handlePostExecution`), and declared in `@objectstack/spec/ui`:
  - `confirmText`: `record`, plus `params` only beside an object of static values (`actionConfirmTemplateRoots`). The runner binds `params` to `action.params` minus `_rowRecord`. An input list binds nothing, because its values are collected after the confirmation.
  - `successMessage`: `result` (the handler's payload) and `record` (`ACTION_SUCCESS_TEMPLATE_ROOTS`).
  - `errorMessage`: none (`ACTION_ERROR_TEMPLATE_ROOTS`). The runner shows an authored `errorMessage` as written. Re-measured at the pin: it fills no hole, as the earlier report said.
- **The judge** (`automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts` `closedScopeTemplateRefusal`) reads a `${…}` token with its `$`. `Delete ${record.name}?` is prescribed `Delete {{ record.name }}?`, no longer `Delete ${{ record.name }}?`. A zero-root scope names every hole and token in its text as literal text. The flow text slots' judge (`textSlotTemplateRefusal`) is unchanged, and the bulk sentence keeps its single-brace wording (pinned).
- **The doors**: a new pass, `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts` `actionCopyTemplateIssues`, runs inside `validateStackExpressions`. That is `objectstack validate`, `compile` and the publish gate. It covers registered actions (top-level, and an object's own, deduplicated), the page action rows and a page component's inline `properties.action`, and judges each locale of an inline map on its own. `page` joins the rule's `runtimeTypes`, and on a page write this pass runs alone. **Every finding is a `warning`**, so it shows as an advisory at the gate and never as a 422.
- **The platform's sentences, converted**: the 4 `invite_user` sentences the ruling names, and the 9 `sys_approval_request` decision toasts (see Deviations). They move from `${result.*}` to `{{ result.* }}` in the source and in every shipped locale bundle. The en bundles were regenerated with `check-i18n-bundles --write`.
- **i18n**: `ActionLike.confirmText` / `successMessage` in `system/i18n-resolver.ts` widen to the envelope. `resolveActionConfirm` / `resolveActionSuccess` answer the authored value as written when no translation applies. `os i18n extract` seeds an envelope like the string (`actionCopy`, through `templateSlotSource`).
- **Expression-surface ledger**: the census (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.test.ts`) scans only `*.zod.ts` files. So the template input is built at each declaring `.zod.ts` file, and all 11 positions are discovered and classified: `template-action-confirm-text`, `template-action-success-message`, `template-action-error-message`. A first cut built them in a plain `.ts` module, and the census never saw them. That is why the construction lives where it does.

## Measured

- **Renderer, re-verified at the pin** (`.objectui-sha` `2958f17e9c6a`, objectui `8e90779dcb` merged in): `actionCopySource` / `fillTemplateHoles` (`packages/core/src/actions/actionCopyTemplate.ts`) read the envelope for all three keys. `useActionTextLocalizer` hands the envelope on, and `flowSuccessCopy` reads it.
- **Producers** (authored `confirmText` / `successMessage` / `errorMessage` in `examples/**` + `packages/**`, tests and generated bundles excluded): at `e649c2d91e`, 13 carried `${…}` (4 platform-objects, 9 plugin-approvals) and 0 carried `{{`. On this branch, 0 carry `${…}` and 13 carry `{{`. In `examples/**`, 0 either way.
- **Downstream shape check** (the unlock's instruction): `OBJECTUI_ROOT=../objectui bash scripts/build-console.sh`, with objectui at `2958f17e9c6a` and this branch's spec built (pre-merge head `3c1eb1e0`). The console's `tsc && vite build` and app-shell's `tsc` completed. Turbo: 36/36 then 34/34 tasks successful. The canaries passed, including "✓ Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it". The merge brought no spec type change this check reads (only #25612's `hideEmpty` describe).

## Tests

- `packages/spec`: new `src/ui/action-copy-template.test.ts`, plus new cases in `src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.test.ts` (`${…}`, zero-root, bulk control). Re-pinned: `ui/action.test.ts`, `ui/component-report-items-action-members-typed.pin.test.ts` (the copy keys written as envelopes stay byte-identical, and the bare-string normalisation is pinned), and `ui/component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts` (the envelopes' `ast`). Full suite before the restructure: 789 of 793 files passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped (the 3 were the fixtures above plus the `export-origins` artifact), and all 3 are fixed. After the restructure, `src/ui/`, `src/system/` and the judge: 211/211 files, 7614 tests.
- `packages/lint`: new `src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts` (13). It drives the real `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` on a `page` write and an `action` write, and asserts one advisory and zero errors. Re-pinned: the meta-test's import-specifier artefact (`templates`) and `runtime-gate.page-visibility-predicate-writes.test.ts` (`validateStackExpressions` now dispatches on `page`). Full suite: 159/159 files, 7250 tests.
- `packages/platform-objects`: 94/94 files, 1343 tests. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals`: 95/95 files, 1244 tests (token pins moved to `{{ }}`, and the parsed copy is read through `templateSlotSource`).
- `packages/cli` unit tier: 327/327 files, 4812 tests.
- `packages/metadata-protocol` `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` (197), `packages/rest` `meta-view-container-i18n.test.ts` (11), `packages/runtime` `action-execution-destructive.test.ts` (63), `services/service-i18n` `authored-translations.test.ts` (16): all pass.
- `packages/qa/dogfood` `expression-conformance.test.ts`: 8/8. `member-transfer-ownership-step-down.dogfood.test.ts` now reads the served copy through `templateSlotSource`. NOT MEASURED locally: it boots the showcase. CI's battery runs it.

## Gates

All runs are at head `e875a564` (the merged head). The derivation is `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 119 families, against merge base `481ac6211`. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe. 115 exited 0 on the first pass. 4 refused with exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (a shallow clone; I fetched the pinned fixture commit), `spec check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` (unbuilt packages). All 4 exited 0 after `turbo run build` (77/77) and the fetch. `--ran` with `cmd :: exit N` reports: "119 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 119 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)".

Also run: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` reports "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". `typecheck` exited 0 on spec, lint, cli, platform-objects, plugin-approvals and dogfood. The local-only `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` both exited 0. The full lint battery and the repo-wide `pnpm lint` are CI's.

One ablation: `isDollarToken` was forced to `return false` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor went 1 to 0, and the blob went `e12c4385` to `38c36986`. `flow-text-slot-template.test.ts` then had 4 failed and 41 passed. The restore left the blob back at `e12c4385` and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Deviations

- **plugin-approvals, 9 sentences, beyond the ruling's "4".** The ruling's count came from the earlier report, which missed `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` (9 `Approved "${result.request.record_title}"`-style toasts). Left alone, the platform would ship 9 sentences its own doors warn on. This conversion meets the four conditions for a bounded in-place fix: the same defect class, a mechanical conversion of the same form, no other open PR touches the file (all open PRs' file lists were read, and only #25612 overlaps, on `component.zod.ts`), and the same gate family. The claim's file surface needs that file and its translations added. The seat should write that addendum, not me.
- **Translated-locale values edited by hand** (zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES `*.objects.generated.ts`, `successMessage` leaves only). AGENTS.md allows this. None of those leaves has a source-hash entry.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/explain.ts`: `confirmText`'s row reads `template (i18n)`, with the hole spelled out.

## Acceptance notes

- `ActionSchema.errorMessage` and `outcomeMessages` are untouched by the ruling. `outcomeMessages` still reads `${result.*}` (the runner fills it that way). They are noted, not filed.
- The Studio action inspector and preview (objectui `ActionDefaultInspector` / `ActionPreview`) read these keys as `I18nLabel` maps and would show an envelope as `template`. This was noted on objectui #13409, and it is an authoring surface outside the runner.
- The bulk row in the expression-surface ledger still says no evaluator. objectui #13183 owns that.
